segments.name: Global Warehousing
segments.description: Owns and operates temperature-controlled warehouses, storing frozen and perishable food and other products and handling pallets for food retailers, manufacturers, processors and distributors.
segments.evidence: Global warehousing, which utilizes our high-quality industrial real estate properties to provide temperature-controlled warehousing storage and services to our customers

segments.name: Global Integrated Solutions
segments.description: Runs temperature-controlled supply chain business lines that move customers' products through the food chain, adding cost savings and extra revenue.
segments.evidence: We operate several critical and value-added temperature-controlled business lines within our global integrated solutions segment, including, among others, transportation and refrigerated rail car leasing.

revenueModel.text: Food retailers, manufacturers, processors and food service distributors pay for temperature-controlled storage, related warehouse handling services and supply chain services.
revenueModel.evidence: Our global warehousing segment revenues are generated from storing frozen and perishable food and other products and providing related warehouse services for our customers.
